text: The author employs an alternating first-person point of view, allowing the narrative to shift between the distinct voices of the space expedition team members. This structural choice highlights the contrasting personalities within the group, specifically moving from the optimistic and curious perspective of the scientist to the pragmatic and cautious outlook of the engineer. The tone is similarly dynamic, adapting to the subject matter at hand. When describing the technical aspects of their mission, such as machinery and encountered phenomena, the language is precise and technical. However, the tone deepens into a reflective and philosophical mode when the characters contemplate their existence and place in the universe.
